title: pgEdge RAG Server hybrid queries can exhaust database and server resources
summary: Unauthenticated queries rebuild a BM25 index from the entire corpus. Work grows with corpus size, enabling denial of service.

severity.rationale: Untrusted callers can exhaust retrieval workers and database resources. Availability impact warrants a 30-day response under the feed rubric.

affected.note: Vendor lists 1.0.0 and earlier, including alpha and beta releases. The GitHub database separately maps the fix commit to a Go pseudo-version.

exposure: Exposed query endpoints with hybrid search enabled are affected; it is enabled by default.

params.instructions: Check the deployed pgEdge RAG Server release, query endpoint access and hybrid-search configuration. Vendor release 2.0.0 contains the fix.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade to 2.0.0 or later. Until then, use an authenticating, rate-limiting proxy or disable hybrid search per pipeline. These mitigations do not replace upgrading.
remediation.risk: Medium. Disabling hybrid search or capping corpus reads reduces keyword recall.

verification: Confirm the deployed release and review search.bm25_max_documents against corpus size.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
